content:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOYBOT] Hotfix queued for inference-frontend -> v2.3.1-hotfix
Reason: tokenization edge-case causing 5xx for short inputs in prod (observed 3% error rate last 10m).
Requested action: expedited deploy + pin to dedicated pool. Change window: immediate (small stagger).
Commands to run:```/deploy start --service=inference-frontend --image=registry.redwood/v2.3.1-hotfix --env=prod --pin=true --stagger=5m```
maria: oncall — can someone confirm rollback plan and blast radius? :eyes:
jordan: confirmed SLO impact limited to short sequences hitting tokenizer. Rollback = deploy previous image v2.3.0 (no migrations). KV caches unaffected.
maria: ok. do we need infra to carve capacity?
ben: infra here, we can pin to dedicated-pool-3, capacity OK for 3 nodes. Recommend 5m stagger and health-check gating.
lina: engineering verified fix in staging. Smoke tests pass. No schema/db changes. +1 from eng.
maria: +1 from oncall if ben and lina sign off. @jordan run the smoke and post logs.
jordan: running smoke now (curl + quick load). Small script:```for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://prod-inference.redwood/api/v1/predict; done```
jordan: smoke: 50/50 200s, latency ~120ms median. sending logs to #eng-telemetry.
ben: infra +1. will monitor infra metrics and pre-warm nodes.
lina: eng +1. no perf regression in staged load test.
maria: oncall +1. proceeding with expedited deploy. Please add release note and pin reason to the PR.
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by @maria. Stagger policy: 5m windows, rollout health checks: 2 consecutive successful probes required per shard.
jordan: monitoring smoke and traces. Posting dashboard link: https://dashboards.redwood/inference/rolling?run=6512349999
maria: gd — if any increase >1% error or p95 jumps >200ms, abort and rollback immediately. Everyone ack? :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
lina: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
maria: leaving note for release-notes team: "Hotfix v2.3.1-hotfix: tokenization edge-case; expedited deploy; rolled back if stability regressions > thresholds."
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to 100% at 6512350148. No health check failures during stagger. Audit: https://audit.redwood/deploys/6512349999
maria: closing thread, logging incident follow-up in #postmortems if anything emerges. Thanks all. :heart:
